source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Cinder game player pixel-art turnaround reference for a Godot portrait 2.5D game. Input image: attached astronaut is a silhouette/detail reference only. Create one original character with a permanently large round astronaut helmet, dark charcoal-blue reflective visor, stepped white rim, a small pale visor highlight, padded moon-white and dusty silver suit, compact chest control panel, small backpack, separated sturdy boots and gloves. Moderately detailed, slightly less resolution/detail than the reference astronaut: each figure should read like a carefully hand-authored 48 x 64 source-pixel sprite, chunky clean pixel clusters, no antialiasing, no gradients. Four equally spaced full-body views on one transparent turnaround sheet: front, back, left, right. All feet at the same baseline, same body height and proportions, no weapons, no action poses. Front should be strongly readable at phone gameplay size; round helmet is roughly one third of character height, torso and limbs have volume from 3-value block shading. Colour palette charcoal outlines, muted navy visor, dusty cool silver and warm moon white, very restrained muted red sleeve bands. Original design, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no stock-image markings, no decorative scene, no glow, no ground shadow. This is a visual model for consistent authored runtime animation.
source.input_role: User-supplied astronaut image was a silhouette and detail reference; it was not cropped into runtime assets.

assets.readiness: Reference only; generated soft alpha/backdrop, unaligned source grid and missing action poses mean this is not a runtime sprite sheet.
